title: Habit 1: Be Proactive
coreMove: Proactivity begins when attention leaves blame and returns to response: language, promises, focus, and values still belong to the chooser.

exampleSpecs.stakes: a crew may blame a caller instead of owning the response
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: replace blame language with an owned next step

exampleSpecs.stakes: a denial can become either resentment or a concrete appeal
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: work inside the circle of influence

exampleSpecs.stakes: one reply may restart an old family script
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: use the pause between stimulus and response
act on controllable conditions instead of mood

exampleSpecs.stakes: angry guests may hear either helplessness or ownership
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: replace cannot language with owned alternatives

exampleSpecs.stakes: a missed booking may cost a week of work
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: honor the commitment that remains possible
